plan_review.notes: 4 blocking + 2 non-blocking concerns. (1) Headless exports in Phaser-bound module → split into arena-data.ts, pure Phaser-free module; tests now import directly from arena-data.ts. (2) Boss spawn path missing attackRange/FamilyMembership → spawnFromArchetype now computes attackRange = detectRange*0.65 for ranged, adds FamilyMembership for floor-2 archetypes. (3) Manual system loop → replaced with runCoreSimulationStep(preSystems=[weaponSystem,enemyAISystem]). (4) Spawn in walls → findWalkablePosition validates FloorMap.isPassableAt, searches 8 neighbors then 16 random fallbacks. (5) Reproducibility → arenaSeed added to settings, crypto.getRandomValues, seed displayed in GUI with new-seed button. (6) Test depth → tests now import from arena-data.ts directly, include FloorMap.isPassableAt validation and attackRange assertions.
